lines: Wet tar plus sunrise equals a street made of gold, briefly.
Somebody ordered rain for the night and sun for the morning, and it was delivered.
The sprinkler goes on at five and it is off again by seven.
Everything green in this photograph is on a timer and everything else is not.
The aloes have not needed a drop of that and they never will.
That lawn is the only thing for forty kilometres that gets a say.
Friday, and by eleven this whole ridge will be one colour again.
